cmd: ethtool -G eth0 tx 256 rx-mini 0 tcp-data-split auto hds-thresh 0
desc: corner: dev=eth0 rx=absent tx=256 rxmini=0 rxjumbo=absent tds=auto hds=0 other=absent
pre: i=$((900+$(ip netns identify | tr -dc 0-9))); echo $i > /sys/bus/netdevsim/del_device 2>/dev/null; echo "$i 1 4" > /sys/bus/netdevsim/new_device && ip link show eth0 >/dev/null
